text: I was looking for a place near my accommodation to get teeth whitening and found this clinic with great reviews. I also asked my host for a recommendation and, coincidentally, he genuinely suggested the same place, so I figured it would be a great choice. Before going, I cleared up several doubts over WhatsApp. I asked if it was possible to do only the whitening, and they said yes — they would still do a free dental check-up (as shown in the photo). I also asked if I could choose the Single package, which included a cleaning and a shorter whitening session (15 min), and, if I felt it was necessary, upgrade to the Double package, which had a longer whitening time (30 min) and didn’t include cleaning (both were the same price, only the inclusions differed). The answer was yes, and that in that case I’d just need to pay for the extra cleaning (as also shown in the photo). So we booked the Single whitening for me and my husband. Everyone treated us very well — I have no complaints about that. However, when we were leaving, the receptionist gave us a bill that included the Double whitening and the Basic check-up package, which we never requested. When we questioned the amount, she issued a new bill, this time correct: Double + cleaning + sterilization, exactly as explained earlier on WhatsApp. Even so, she said she was giving us a “discount,” when in fact that was just the proper price. The whitening was indeed done for 30 minutes (Double), but we didn’t like that no one asked beforehand if we wanted to upgrade. As for the results, mine was satisfactory, but my husband’s was a bit below expectations — although we understand that can vary from person to person. Overall, the service was good, but we really didn’t like how the billing part was handled.

What more can I say — keep up the great work, you are the best!
